::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions/{sub}/items"}
#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `sub` | `string` | **yes** | Subscription id (sub_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `price` | `string` | **yes** | The price's id (a slug id, e.g. `pro-monthly-usd`). |
| `quantity` | `integer` | no | The quantity. Defaults to `1`. |
| `unit_price_minor` | `integer` | no | Custom price override (flat/per-unit only), minor units |
| `invoice_immediately` | `boolean` | no | Where the prorated charge lands — the same Invoicing Option POST …/change carries. true raises the invoice now and collects it; false queues the line as an unbilled charge folded into the next renewal invoice (where tax and account credits are applied), and the response then carries `unbilled_charges` instead of `proration_invoice`. OMITTED resolves the business setting `default_invoice_immediately` (off by default), exactly as /change does — so a composition edit applied as several calls lands on one answer. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `subscription_item`. One of `subscription_item`. |
| `id` | `string` | The subscription item id. |
| `price` | `string` | The price id. |
| `quantity` | `integer` | The quantity. |
| `proration_invoice` | `object` | The invoice that the change raised, or null if it raised none. |
| `unbilled_charges` | `array of object` | Present only when the charge was queued instead of invoiced. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Item added |
| `400` | Invalid |
| `404` | No such subscription/price |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different payload, or a request with it is still in progress |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/subscriptions/sub_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/items" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "price": "pro-monthly-usd",
    "quantity": 1
  }'
```
